/obj/item/encryptionkey/headset_cargo.reason: Adds one more channel for talking to your own ship. Crews can already talk freely.

/obj/item/encryptionkey/syndicate.name: syndicate encryption key
/obj/item/encryptionkey/syndicate.reason: Adds a galaxy-wide channel only other syndicate keys hear, and jamming fields don't stop it. Good for allied crews. It can't overhear anyone else. Ruins only.

/obj/item/ew_exploit/breaker_trip.name: exploit cartridge (Breaker Trip)
/obj/item/ew_exploit/breaker_trip.reason: Turns off equipment and lights on every APC aboard the enemy ship for 30 seconds. Crew can flip them back by hand, one at a time. Three uses, needs a suite.

/obj/item/ew_exploit/comms_blackout.name: exploit cartridge (Comms Blackout)
/obj/item/ew_exploit/comms_blackout.reason: Jams the enemy crew's internal radio for 60 seconds; wideband still works. Hurts a crew that relies on callouts, does nothing to NPC ships. Four uses, needs a suite.

/obj/item/ew_exploit/door_seize.name: exploit cartridge (Bolt Override)
/obj/item/ew_exploit/door_seize.reason: Bolts every enemy airlock for 30 seconds, or unbolts them all for your boarders. The cartridge a boarding party wants. Five uses, needs a suite.

/obj/item/ew_exploit/drive_lockout.name: exploit cartridge (Drive Lockout)
/obj/item/ew_exploit/drive_lockout.reason: Enemy ship can't thrust for 25 seconds, so it can't run or dodge. Stops NPC ships too. Three uses, needs a suite.

/obj/item/ew_exploit/fire_control_freeze.name: exploit cartridge (Fire-Control Freeze)
/obj/item/ew_exploit/fire_control_freeze.reason: Enemy missiles and lasers can't fire for 20 seconds. Three uses, needs a suite. A quick purge from the target's weapons console ends it early.

/obj/item/ew_exploit/helm_poltergeist.name: exploit cartridge (Poltergeist)
/obj/item/ew_exploit/helm_poltergeist.reason: Throws an enemy ship onto a random heading every 3 seconds for 20 seconds and breaks its autopilot. Two uses, sold only for vouchers, needs a suite.

/obj/item/ew_exploit/lights_out.name: exploit cartridge (Blackout)
/obj/item/ew_exploit/lights_out.reason: Turns off the enemy ship's lights for 45 seconds. An annoyance, and a real edge only if your boarders have night vision. Five uses, needs a suite.

/obj/item/ew_exploit/overvolt_doors.name: exploit cartridge (Overvolt)
/obj/item/ew_exploit/overvolt_doors.reason: Electrifies every enemy airlock for 30 seconds. Slows a crew moving between rooms and hurts anyone without insulated gloves. Four uses, needs a suite.

/obj/item/ew_exploit/phantom_klaxons.name: exploit cartridge (Phantom Klaxons)
/obj/item/ew_exploit/phantom_klaxons.reason: Drops every firelock on the enemy ship and sounds the alarms for 30 seconds. An annoyance a crowbar answers. Five uses, needs a suite.

/obj/item/ew_exploit/runaway_burn.name: exploit cartridge (Runaway Burn)
/obj/item/ew_exploit/runaway_burn.reason: Pins the enemy throttle at full burn for 15 seconds with the helm dead. Nasty against a ship at speed, weak against a parked one. Two uses, vouchers only, needs a suite.

/obj/item/ew_exploit/sensor_ghosts.name: exploit cartridge (Ghost Contacts)
/obj/item/ew_exploit/sensor_ghosts.reason: Paints three fake ships on the enemy helm for 2 minutes. Confusing the first time, then crews learn the tell. Does nothing to NPC ships. Four uses, needs a suite.

/obj/item/ew_exploit/shield_collapse.name: exploit cartridge (Shield Collapse)
/obj/item/ew_exploit/shield_collapse.reason: Hacks an enemy ship's shields down for 30 seconds from range, and even a fast purge only brings them back at half charge. Three uses, needs an electronic warfare suite. The strongest cartridge.

/obj/item/ew_exploit/system_scramble.name: exploit cartridge (Scrambler)
/obj/item/ew_exploit/system_scramble.reason: Knocks an enemy ship's interdictor and cloak offline and keeps them down for 45 seconds. Useless against a ship with neither. Four uses, needs a suite.

/obj/item/ew_exploit/vent_purge.name: exploit cartridge (Vent Purge)
/obj/item/ew_exploit/vent_purge.reason: Every air alarm on the enemy ship starts siphoning the air for 45 seconds. The only cartridge that can kill crew, but it warns them loudly and anyone on internals shrugs it off. Four uses, needs a suite.

/obj/item/jammer/makeshift.name: makeshift radio jammer
/obj/item/jammer/makeshift.reason: Crafted from a key, cable and a scanner. Jams radios within 5 tiles and can knock headsets 3 tiles away off the air. Useful on a boarding, does no damage.

/obj/item/megaphone.reason: Makes your voice loud. No bearing on anything else.

/obj/item/radio/listening_coin.name: worn credit chit
/obj/item/radio/listening_coin.reason: Authored unique from ruin caches: a bugged credit chit with a paired earpiece that hears what is said within 2 tiles of it. Small power. It is here only because it should never sit on a shelf.

/obj/item/radio/mech.name: station bounced radio
/obj/item/radio/mech.reason: The radio built into a mech's radio module. Not something a player carries around.

/obj/item/radio/off.name: station bounced radio
/obj/item/radio/off.reason: A handheld radio. Common and prints at round start.

/obj/item/radio/weather_monitor.name: mining weather radio
/obj/item/radio/weather_monitor.reason: Warns of storms before they hit a planet. Saves a careless away team; a careful one watches the sky. Costs mining points.

method: Radios rate by what they add beyond talking to your own ship, which everyone can already do. Hacking cartridges rate by what one use does to an enemy ship, assuming the crew owns the rep 11 suite they need. No formula, and no play data on hacking.
